facts.label: Degree + 3–5 years of business experience
facts.detail: Admission requires either an approved business/business-management degree and at least three equivalent full-time years of relevant business administrative, operational, leadership or management experience in the past ten years, or an approved degree in another discipline and at least five such years. The university reviews degree accreditation or foreign equivalency. A 2.5 cumulative GPA on the transcript for the conferred degree is required. Transfer grades from another institution are excluded from this admission GPA.

facts.label: State and individual admission apply
facts.detail: Phoenix offers this exact program online, but published availability varies by state and enrollment demand. The university must evaluate your official degree/GPA/work-experience records and state eligibility before enrollment; a ready course plan is not an admission approval.

facts.label: Self-paced within 16-week terms
facts.detail: Work through faculty-supported groups of three to four courses within sixteen-week periods. This program charges per credit and is not an unlimited-course subscription.

facts.label: Degree + 3–5 years of IT/business experience
facts.detail: Admission requires either an approved degree in business, computer science, information technology or a related field and at least three equivalent full-time years of IT or relevant administrative, operational, leadership or management experience in the past ten years, or an approved degree in another discipline and at least five such years. Experience must be in an IT or business environment. A 2.5 cumulative GPA on the transcript for the conferred degree is required. Transfer grades from another institution are excluded from this admission GPA.

facts.label: State and individual admission apply
facts.detail: Phoenix offers this exact program online, but published availability varies by state and enrollment demand. The university must evaluate your official degree/GPA/work-experience records and state eligibility before enrollment; a ready course plan is not an admission approval.

facts.label: Self-paced within 16-week terms
facts.detail: Work through faculty-supported groups of three to four courses within sixteen-week periods. This program charges per credit and is not an unlimited-course subscription.

facts.label: Healthcare leadership experience required
facts.detail: Have an approved bachelor's degree or higher, or a comparable recognized foreign qualification; the university evaluates degree accreditation and transcript eligibility. Have at least three equivalent full-time years of healthcare leadership or management experience in the past ten years, including oversight or management of staff. A 2.5 cumulative GPA on the transcript for the conferred degree is required; transfer grades from other institutions are excluded from this admission GPA.

facts.label: Healthcare workplace access required
facts.detail: Be employed in healthcare or have access to a healthcare environment for course assignments.

facts.label: State and individual admission apply
facts.detail: Phoenix offers this exact program online, but published availability varies by state and enrollment demand. The university must evaluate your official degree/GPA/work-experience records and state eligibility before enrollment; a ready course plan is not an admission approval.

facts.label: Self-paced within 16-week terms
facts.detail: Work through faculty-supported groups of three to four courses within sixteen-week periods. This program charges per credit and is not an unlimited-course subscription.

facts.label: Degree + 3 years of work experience
facts.detail: Have an undergraduate degree or higher and a cumulative GPA of at least 2.5; the university evaluates recognized accreditation, transcripts and any applicable international-admission requirements. Have at least three equivalent full-time years of work experience within the past ten years.

facts.label: Not a psychologist licensing program
facts.detail: This educational psychology degree does not prepare students for professional psychologist certification or licensure. It must not be treated as an approved clinical, counseling or psychologist licensing pathway.

facts.label: Not eligible for federal financial aid
facts.detail: This exact Master of Science in Psychology Direct Assessment program is not eligible for Title IV federal financial aid. Plan financing for its paid twelve-week terms accordingly.

facts.label: State and individual admission apply
facts.detail: Phoenix offers this exact program online, but published availability varies by state and enrollment demand. The university must evaluate your official degree/GPA/work-experience records and state eligibility before enrollment; a ready course plan is not an admission approval.

facts.label: Self-paced within 12-week terms
facts.detail: Choose two, three or four three-CU courses per twelve-week term, with at most twelve CUs per term and thirty-nine graduate CUs per twelve months. Faculty-supported mastery controls progress within that schedule; the subscription is not unlimited.
